property_summary: For any caller (owner) and any uint256 amount, after calling AdjustBetAmounts(amount) the contract's betLimit equals the amount passed; the mutant does not change betLimit but corrupts the unrelated difficulty when AdjustDifficulty is later called by the same owner, so the distinguishing rule is: calling AdjustBetAmounts(amount) then calling AdjustDifficulty(amount2) as owner leaves betLimit equal to the first amount and difficulty equal to the second amount — the reference always sets difficulty to the provided second amount, while the mutant sets difficulty to uint160(msg.sender) (thus differing for many owner addresses).
change_summary: Assigns difficulty from msg.sender (address cast) instead of using the provided amount, changing stored difficulty after AdjustDifficulty is called.
